# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tools_doc.py from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `python scripts/gen_tools_doc.py`. -->

The NetLicensing MCP server has 62 tools in 11 toolsets, plus 11 prompts. This page lists all of them, as the server registers them with every toolset enabled. `MCP_TOOLSETS` and `MCP_READ_ONLY` shrink the list a client sees; see [Reduce the tool list / read-only mode](../README.md#reduce-the-tool-list--read-only-mode).

Badges: **R** = read-only, **W** = writes data, **D** = destructive (deletes data). They follow the tool annotations (`readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`) that the server sends to clients.

Every parameter that is not required may be left out; the default is what the tool then uses. String parameters with the default `""` mean "not set" (on updates: "leave unchanged").

### `netlicensing_list_products`

**List products** · R · `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=true`

List all products in the NetLicensing account.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | no | `""` |  |
| `page` | integer \| null | no | `null` | Page to return, 0-based (default 0; overrides 'page' in filter) |
| `page_size` | integer \| null | no | `null` | Items per page, 1-100 (default 25; overrides 'items' in filter) |
| `compact` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, return only type, number, name, status and active for each item |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization) |

### `netlicensing_preview_update_product`

**Preview update of product** · R · `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=true`

Preview a sensitive product update (licenseeAutoCreate or vatMode change).

Returns a diff of proposed changes and a confirmation token. Pass the
token to netlicensing_update_product within 5 minutes to apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | string | yes | — | Product to preview changes for |
| `licensee_auto_create` | boolean \| null | no | `null` | Proposed new auto-create setting (omit to skip) |
| `vat_mode` | string | no | `""` | Proposed new VAT mode — GROSS or NET (leave empty to skip) |

| `licensing_info` | string | no | `""` | Licensing information for the shop (leave empty to keep current) |
| `licensee_auto_create` | boolean \| null | no | `null` | Auto-create licensees on first validation |
| `vat_mode` | string | no | `""` | GROSS or NET (leave empty to keep current) |
| `licensee_secret_mode` | string | no | `""` | DISABLED, PREDEFINED, or CLIENT (leave empty to keep current) |
| `confirm_token` | string | no | `""` | Confirmation token (required when licenseeAutoCreate or vatMode change) |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization) |

### `netlicensing_preview_delete_product`

**Preview deletion of product** · R · `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=true`

Preview what would be deleted when deleting a product.

Returns affected counts (modules, license templates, licensees, licenses and
bundles; "unknown" when too many to count cheaply), sample entity identifiers,
`requires_force_cascade` and `blocking_dependencies` (a product with
modules or licensees cannot be deleted without force_cascade), and a short-lived confirmation token. The
token is bound to the force_cascade value used here: pass the same value,
with the token, to netlicensing_delete_product within 5 minutes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | string | yes | — | Product to preview deletion for |
| `force_cascade` | boolean | no | `false` | Preview a cascade delete (also removes dependent modules, templates, licensees and licenses; bundles that use the product's templates are reported too) |

### `netlicensing_delete_product`

**Delete product** · D · `destructiveHint=true`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=false`

Delete a product permanently.

Always requires a two-step confirmation:
1. Call without confirm_token (or call netlicensing_preview_delete_product,
   which shows the dependencies and whether force_cascade is required) to
   receive a preview and a short-lived confirmation token.
2. Call again with the confirm_token and the same force_cascade value within
   5 minutes to execute. A token issued for a non-cascade delete is rejected
   for force_cascade=true and the reverse.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | string | yes | — | Product to delete |
| `force_cascade` | boolean | no | `false` | Also delete all dependent modules, templates, licensees, and licenses (bundles are NOT deleted: they are orphaned and reported) |
| `confirm_token` | string | no | `""` | Confirmation token from a previous preview call (not proof of human approval: show the preview to the user and wait for their go-ahead) |

### `netlicensing_obtain_bundle`

**Obtain bundle** · W · `destructiveHint=false`, `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=false`

Obtain a bundle for a customer — creates licenses from all license
templates included in the bundle for the specified licensee.

Pricing: the created licenses carry the price of their license templates. In
testing, a bundle priced 5.00 EUR produced a license at its template price
(1.00 EUR); the bundle price is what the Shop charges. Check the created
licenses' prices if they matter.

NOT idempotent: every call issues a new set of licenses. To make a retry safe,
the call is refused when the customer already holds licenses from this bundle's
templates; after an unclear response, list the customer's licenses before
calling again, and pass allow_duplicate=true only for a deliberate second set.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle_number` | string | yes | — | Bundle to obtain |
| `licensee_number` | string | yes | — | Customer (licensee) who receives the licenses |
| `allow_duplicate` | boolean | no | `false` | Obtain even if the customer already has licenses from this bundle (default false) |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization) |

   to receive a preview and a short-lived confirmation token.
2. Call again with the confirm_token within 5 minutes to execute.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `licensee_number` | string | yes | — | Licensee to delete |
| `force_cascade` | boolean | no | `false` | Also delete all dependent licenses |
| `confirm_token` | string | no | `""` | Confirmation token from a previous preview call (not proof of human approval: show the preview to the user and wait for their go-ahead) |

### `netlicensing_validate_licensee`

**Validate licensee** · W · `destructiveHint=false`, `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=false`

Validate a customer's licenses across all product modules.

Returns the list envelope with one ProductModuleValidation item per module
(validity, type, expiry, usage; Floating expirationTimestamp and session data
are kept), even when only one module is validated. API infos (ERROR, WARNING,
INFO — e.g. "No free floating licenses found.") appear in 'warnings'.

Module-scoped parameters (session_id, action, node_secret) require
product_module_number, and one call addresses ONE module. A call that is not
a dry run still validates every module of the product, so other Floating or
NodeLocked modules may report their own missing-parameter errors.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `licensee_number` | string | yes | — | Customer to validate |
| `product_number` | string | no | `""` | Optional — scope validation to a specific product |
| `licensee_name` | string | no | `""` | Human-readable name for auto-created licensees (when licenseeAutoCreate is enabled) |
| `session_id` | string | no | `""` | Floating model — unique session identifier (needs product_module_number; required with action) |
| `action` | string | no | `""` | Floating model — 'checkOut' or 'checkIn' (needs product_module_number and session_id) |
| `product_module_number` | string | no | `""` | Module that session_id / action / node_secret apply to; required when any of them is given |
| `node_secret` | string | no | `""` | NodeLocked model — unique device/node secret (needs product_module_number) |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, validate without side effects: never checks out, checks in, binds a node or consumes anything. Default false. |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization) |

### `netlicensing_transfer_licenses`

**Transfer licenses** · W · `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=false`

Transfer all licenses from one licensee to another.

The source licensee must be marked for transfer (markedForTransfer=true)
and both licensees must be active. The source licensee is consumed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_licensee_number` | string | yes | — | Source licensee |
| `to_licensee_number` | string | yes | — | Destination licensee |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | Accepted for consistency; the API returns no body (204) |

| `active` | boolean | no | `true` | Whether the transaction is active |
| `date_created` | string | no | `""` | Not supported — NetLicensing sets the creation time itself; a value is rejected (leave empty) |
| `date_closed` | string | no | `""` | Not supported — NetLicensing sets the close time itself; a value is rejected (leave empty) |
| `payment_method` | string | no | `""` | Optional payment method number |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization) |

### `netlicensing_update_transaction`

**Update transaction** · W · `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=false`

Update a transaction's status or properties.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction_number` | string | yes | — | Transaction to update |
| `status` | string | no | `""` | CANCELLED \| CLOSED \| PENDING (leave empty to keep current) |
| `active` | boolean \| null | no | `null` | Set active state (omit to keep current) |
| `name` | string | no | `""` | Human-readable name (leave empty to keep current) |
| `date_closed` | string | no | `""` | Not supported — NetLicensing sets the close time itself; a value is rejected (leave empty). Note: a CLOSED transaction can be set back to PENDING and keeps its old close time; there is no delete tool, so cancel unwanted transactions |
| `payment_method` | string | no | `""` | Payment method number (leave empty to keep current) |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When true, include the sanitized NetLicensing API response under 'raw' (the upstream reply, before this tool's normalization) |

### `netlicensing_server_info`

**Get server info** · R · `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=true`

Check this MCP server's setup and its NetLicensing connection.

Call this FIRST on a new setup, and whenever another tool fails with an
authentication, connection or configuration error: 'status' ("ok",
"warning" or "error") and 'next_steps' (plain-language sentences to pass
on to the user) say what to fix.

Returns version, NetLicensing API host (base_url), demo_mode, transport
(stdio or http), toolsets, read_only and tool_count, plus 'auth'
({configured, source: env|header|demo|none, valid: true|false|null}),
'checks' ([{name, ok, detail}]) and 'warnings'. Never returns the API key.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `check_connection` | boolean | no | `true` | When true (default), make one cheap read-only API call (list one product, short timeout) to check that the API is reachable and accepts the credentials; when false, make no API call (auth.valid stays null) |

## Toolset `workflows`

| Tool | Title | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`netlicensing_get_customer_health`](#netlicensing_get_customer_health) | Get customer health | R | Return a normalized health summary for one licensee. |
| [`netlicensing_explain_validation`](#netlicensing_explain_validation) | Explain validation | R | Run a dry-run validation and return a plain-language explanation. |

### `netlicensing_get_customer_health`

**Get customer health** · R · `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=true`

Return a normalized health summary for one licensee.

Combines licensee details, license list, and (optionally) a dry-run
validation into a single CustomerHealth envelope with per-module rows,
warnings, and suggested actions. This tool is READ-ONLY — it never
modifies data or consumes quota.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `licensee_number` | string | yes | — | Licensee identifier (e.g. 'CUST-ACME'). |
| `refresh_warning_level` | boolean | no | `false` | When True, runs a dry-run validate_licensee to get live warning levels and quota/session info. Slightly slower but more accurate. |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When True, include the sanitized upstream NetLicensing API responses (licensee, licenses, validation) under 'raw'. |

### `netlicensing_explain_validation`

**Explain validation** · R · `openWorldHint=true`, `readOnlyHint=true`

Run a dry-run validation and return a plain-language explanation.

Wraps validate_licensee with dryRun=true and translates the result into
per-module status, explanations, and suggested_actions (renewal tokens,
top-up flows, force-checkin advice). This tool is READ-ONLY — it never
consumes floating sessions, quota, or node-lock slots.

Note: module_parameters passes the first entry's fields only (one module per
call). Its session_id is honoured: a Floating module validated with one is not
described as missing a session id. The status of the other Floating modules of
the product stays "unknown" (valid=false upstream) unless you validate them too.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `licensee_number` | string | yes | — | Licensee identifier (e.g. 'CUST-ACME'). |
| `product_number` | string | no | `""` | Optional — scope validation to a single product. |
| `module_parameters` | array of object \| null | no | `null` | Optional per-module overrides. Each dict may contain: product_module_number, node_secret, session_id, action. |
| `include_raw` | boolean | no | `false` | When True, include the sanitized upstream validate_licensee API response under 'raw'. |

## Prompts

Prompts are always registered, whatever `MCP_TOOLSETS` and `MCP_READ_ONLY` say.

### Audits

| Prompt | Purpose | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| [`audit_full`](#audit_full) | Run a full entitlement audit across all customers of a product. | `product_number` |
| [`audit_customer`](#audit_customer) | Deep-dive audit of a single customer's license health. | `licensee_number` |
| [`audit_expiry`](#audit_expiry) | Find customers whose licenses expired or expire within N days, with renewal URLs. | `product_number`, `days_threshold` (optional) |
| [`audit_cleanup`](#audit_cleanup) | Identify inactive, unused, or orphaned licenses for cleanup. | `product_number` |
| [`audit_anomaly`](#audit_anomaly) | Detect anomalous usage patterns across all customers. | `product_number` |

#### `audit_full`

Run a full entitlement audit across all customers of a product.

Lists the product's modules and licensees, validates every licensee and
lists their licenses, then reports compliant, failing and at-risk
customers (expiring within 30 days or under 10% quota left), statistics
and prioritized actions.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | yes | The NetLicensing product number to audit (e.g. 'P001') |

#### `audit_customer`

Deep-dive audit of a single customer's license health.

Checks the licensee's profile, validates every module and lists its
licenses, then reports the overall status, issues and recommended
actions. For an expired or invalid entitlement it also generates a Shop
renewal URL.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `licensee_number` | yes | The licensee number to audit (e.g. 'I001') |

#### `audit_expiry`

Find customers whose licenses expired or expire within N days, with renewal URLs.

Validates every licensee of the product, lists the already expired and
the soon-expiring entitlements, and generates a Shop renewal URL for
each expired or at-risk customer.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | yes | Product number to sweep |
| `days_threshold` | no | Flag licenses expiring within this many days (default 30) |

#### `audit_cleanup`

Identify inactive, unused, or orphaned licenses for cleanup.

Finds licensees of the product with no active license, with a mix of
active and inactive licenses, or with floating / quantity quota used up,
and recommends deactivation, deletion or a renewal. It changes nothing
without the user's confirmation.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | yes | Product number to inspect |

#### `audit_anomaly`

Detect anomalous usage patterns across all customers.

Validates every licensee of the product and lists their licenses, then
looks for usage anomalies (high consumption, maxed-out floating seats),
configuration anomalies (licenses from inactive templates, duplicates)
and compliance anomalies (validation fails although licenses are
active), ranked by severity.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | yes | Product number to analyse |

### Setup and troubleshooting

| Prompt | Purpose | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| [`setup_subscription_product`](#setup_subscription_product) | Create a product with a Subscription module and one TIMEVOLUME template per plan. | `product_name`, `plans` |
| [`setup_trial`](#setup_trial) | Add a Try & Buy module to a product: a free, automatic TIMEVOLUME trial template and a FEATURE full-version template. | `product_number`, `trial_days` (optional) |
| [`onboard_customer`](#onboard_customer) | Create a licensee, assign a license from a template (or a bundle) and validate it with a dry run. | `customer_name`, `product_number`, `licensee_number` (optional), `module_number` (optional), `license_template_number` (optional) |
| [`migrate_customer`](#migrate_customer) | Preview both licensees and their licenses, then move all licenses from one licensee to another with `netlicensing_transfer_licenses`. | `from_licensee_number`, `to_licensee_number` |
| [`troubleshoot_validation`](#troubleshoot_validation) | Find out why a licensee's validation fails and how to fix it, without side effects: setup check, dry-run validation, plain-language explanation, customer health. | `licensee_number`, `product_number` (optional), `product_module_number` (optional) |
| [`issue_api_key`](#issue_api_key) | Pick the least-privilege API key role for a purpose and create the key, which is shown once. | `purpose` |

#### `setup_subscription_product`

**Set up a subscription product**

Create a product with a Subscription module and one TIMEVOLUME template per plan.

Checks that the Subscription model and the TIMEVOLUME type are available,
plans the product, module and one license template per plan (period and
price), optionally with a grace period or a free evaluation template,
and creates them after confirmation.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_name` | yes | Name of the new product, e.g. 'Acme Cloud' |
| `plans` | yes | Subscription plans as period and price, e.g. '1 MONTH 9.99 EUR; 1 YEAR 99.00 EUR' (periods: DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR) |

#### `setup_trial`

**Add a free trial to a product**

Add a Try & Buy module to a product: a free, automatic TIMEVOLUME trial
template and a FEATURE full-version template.

The trial template is hidden in the Shop; the full version carries the
purchase price. An existing automatic trial is reused instead of
creating a second one, and licenseeAutoCreate can be turned on after a
preview.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_number` | yes | Existing product to add the trial to |
| `trial_days` | no | Length of the free trial in days (default 14) |

#### `onboard_customer`

**Onboard a customer**

Create a licensee, assign a license from a template (or a bundle) and
validate it with a dry run.

Reuses a matching existing licensee if the user agrees, assigns the
license after confirmation, explains a failed validation, and can create
a one-time Shop checkout URL.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_name` | yes | Customer (licensee) display name |
| `product_number` | yes | Product the customer licenses |
| `licensee_number` | no | Licensee number to use (empty: auto-generated by NetLicensing) |
| `module_number` | no | Product module to pick the license template from (optional) |
| `license_template_number` | no | License template to assign (optional; asked when empty) |

#### `migrate_customer`

**Move a customer's licenses to another licensee**

Preview both licensees and their licenses, then move all licenses from one
licensee to another with `netlicensing_transfer_licenses`.

After confirmation it prepares the licensees where needed
(markedForTransfer on the source, active state) before the transfer.
The source licensee is consumed by the transfer.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `from_licensee_number` | yes | Source licensee |
| `to_licensee_number` | yes | Destination licensee |

#### `troubleshoot_validation`

**Troubleshoot a failing validation**

Find out why a licensee's validation fails and how to fix it, without side
effects: setup check, dry-run validation, plain-language explanation,
customer health.

Ends with a diagnosis per module and the tool calls that fix it, which
are run only after the user confirms.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `licensee_number` | yes | Licensee whose validation fails |
| `product_number` | no | Product to scope the validation to (optional) |
| `product_module_number` | no | Product module that fails (optional) |

#### `issue_api_key`

**Issue a scoped API key**

Pick the least-privilege API key role for a purpose and create the key,
which is shown once.

The key can be scoped to one licensee. It is created after confirmation
and never repeated afterwards; the prompt also explains how to revoke it.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `purpose` | yes | What the key is for, e.g. 'license validation in our desktop app' or 'nightly reporting' |
